journal_name: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists

articles.title_en: Unemployment, Labor Mobility, and Climate Policy
articles.title_cn: 失业、劳动力流动与气候政策
articles.abstract_en: We develop a computable general equilibrium model of the US economy to study the unemployment effects of climate policy and the importance of cross-industry labor mobility. We consider two specifications of mobility costs: either perfect mobility with no moving costs, as is assumed in much previous work, or a model where workers face moving costs. The effect of a $45 per ton carbon tax on aggregate unemployment is small and similar across the two labor mobility assumptions (0.2 percentage points). The effect on unemployment in fossil fuel sectors is much larger under the immobility assumption—for example, a 13-percentage-point increase in the coal sector unemployment rate—suggesting that models omitting labor mobility frictions may greatly underpredict sectoral unemployment effects. Returning carbon tax revenue through labor tax cuts can dampen or even reverse negative impacts on unemployment, while command-and-control policies yield less efficient outcomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个美国经济的可计算一般均衡模型，以研究气候政策的失业效应以及跨行业劳动力流动的重要性。我们考虑两种流动成本设定：要么如许多先前研究假设的那样，不存在流动成本的完全流动，要么是工人面临流动成本的模型。每吨碳税45美元对总体失业的影响很小，且在两种劳动力流动假设下相似（0.2个百分点）。在不可流动假设下，对化石燃料部门失业的影响要大得多——例如，煤炭部门失业率上升13个百分点——这表明忽略劳动力流动摩擦的模型可能大大低估部门失业效应。通过劳动税削减返还碳税收入可以减弱甚至逆转对失业的负面影响，而命令控制型政策产生的结果效率较低。

articles.title_en: The Effect of Income on Vehicle Demand: Evidence from China’s New Vehicle Market
articles.title_cn: 收入对汽车需求的影响：来自中国新车市场的证据
articles.abstract_en: As incomes continue rising, vehicle ownership is expected to grow dramatically in China and other emerging countries. For these countries, little causal evidence exists on the effect of income on vehicle ownership. Using city-level data on new car registrations and income in China from 2005 to 2017 and using export-led growth to isolate plausibly exogenous income variation, we estimate an elasticity of new car sales to income of about 2.5. Recent projections of vehicle sales in China have understated actual sales by 36%. To meet its climate objectives, China will need more aggressive policies than previous forecasts indicate.
articles.abstract_cn: 随着收入持续增长，中国和其他新兴国家的汽车保有量预计将大幅增长。对于这些国家，关于收入对汽车保有量影响的因果证据很少。使用中国从2005到2017的城市级新车注册和收入数据，并利用出口导向型增长来分离出看似外生的收入变化，我们估计新车销售对收入的弹性约为2.5。近期对中国汽车销售的预测低估了实际销量36%。为实现其气候目标，中国将需要比先前预测所表明的更为激进的政策。

articles.title_cn: 温度与低风险认知表现
articles.abstract_en: This study offers some of the first evidence in a developing country context that transitory exposure to high temperatures may disrupt low-stakes cognitive activities across a range of age cohorts. By matching eight years of repeated cognitive tests among all the participants in a nationally representative longitudinal survey in China with weather data according to the exact time and geographic location of their assessment, we show that exposure to a temperature above 32°C on the test date, relative to a moderate day within 22°C–24°C, leads to a sizable decline in their math scores by 0.066 standard deviations (equivalent to 0.23 years of education). Further, the effect on the math test scores is more salient for individuals who are older or less educated.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究提供了发展中国家背景下的一些首批证据，表明短暂暴露于高温可能会干扰不同年龄队列的一系列低风险认知活动。通过将中国一项全国代表性纵向调查中所有参与者在八年内重复进行的认知测试与根据其评估的确切时间和地理位置匹配的天气数据进行匹配，我们发现，在测试日期暴露于高于32°C的温度，相对于在22°C–24°C范围内的温和日子，会导致其数学成绩大幅下降0.066个标准差（相当于0.23年的教育）。此外，对数学测试成绩的影响在年龄较大或受教育程度较低的人群中更为显著。

articles.title_cn: 行为动机下的庇古政策
articles.abstract_en: This study investigates the role of Pigouvian policy when producers and consumers may have direct preferences or “behavioral motives” that cause them to take voluntary actions to address externalities. Building from microfoundations, I construct a model of behavioral motives and analyze their implications for policy. In addition to the damage function, the optimal Pigouvian price will depend upon behavioral responses to policy and normative judgments regarding whether behavioral motives are welfare relevant. The “normative uncertainty” regarding whether behavioral motives are welfare relevant may be even more consequential for the optimal Pigouvian tax than uncertainty regarding the damage function. Thus, focusing solely on careful empirical estimation of behavioral motives is insufficient for setting policy. I elucidate diverse applications for the model and discuss normative implications for existing research on green markets, warm glow, and social and moral norms.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究考察当生产者和消费者可能具有直接偏好或“行为动机”，从而促使他们采取自愿行动应对外部性时，庇古政策的作用。我从微观基础出发，构建了一个行为动机模型，并分析其对政策的含义。除了损害函数外，最优庇古价格将取决于对政策的行为反应，以及关于行为动机是否与福利相关的规范性判断。关于行为动机是否与福利相关的“规范性不确定性”，对最优庇古税的影响可能比关于损害函数的不确定性更为重大。因此，仅专注于对行为动机进行细致的实证估计，不足以制定政策。我阐明了该模型的多种应用，并讨论了其对关于绿色市场、暖光以及社会与道德规范的现有研究的规范性含义。

articles.title_en: California’s GHG Cap-and-Trade Program and the Equity of Air Toxic Releases
Input Efficiency as a Solution to Externalities and Resource Scarcity: A Randomized Controlled Trial
articles.title_cn: 投入效率作为外部性和资源稀缺的解决方案：一项随机对照试验
articles.abstract_en: Resource-conserving technologies are widely reported to benefit both the people who adopt them and the environment. Evidence for these “win-win” claims comes largely from modeling or nonexperimental designs and mostly from the energy sector. In a randomized trial of water-efficient technologies, the ex ante engineering estimate of water use reductions was three times higher than the experimental estimate, a divergence arising from engineering and behavioral reasons other than the rebound effect. Using detailed cost information and experimentally elicited time and risk preferences, we infer that the private welfare gains from adoption are, on average, negative, implying no “efficiency paradox.”.
articles.abstract_cn: 资源节约型技术被广泛报道为既有利于采用者也有利于环境。这些“双赢”主张的证据主要来自建模或非实验设计，且大多来自能源部门。在一项节水技术的随机试验中，事前工程估计的用水减少量是实验估计的三倍，这一差异源于工程和行为方面的原因，而非反弹效应。利用详细的成本信息和实验引出的时间与风险偏好，我们推断采用带来的私人福利收益平均为负，这意味着不存在“效率悖论”。

articles.title_en: Climate Finance Intermediation: Interest Spread Effects in a Climate Policy Model
articles.title_cn: 气候金融中介：气候政策模型中的利差效应
articles.abstract_en: Interest rates are central determinants of saving and investment decisions. Costly financial intermediation distorts these price signals by creating a spread between deposit and loan rates. This study investigates how bank spreads affect climate policy in its ambition to redirect capital. We identify various channels through which interest spreads affect carbon emissions in a dynamic general equilibrium model. Interest rate spreads increase abatement costs due to the higher relative price for capital-intensive carbon-free energy, but they also tend to reduce emissions due to lower overall economic growth. For the global average interest rate spread of 5.1 percentage points, global warming increases by 0.2°C compared to the frictionless economy. For a given temperature target to be achieved, interest rate spreads necessitate substantially higher carbon taxes. When spreads arise from imperfect competition in the intermediation sector, the associated welfare costs can be reduced by clean energy subsidies or even eliminated by economy-wide investment subsidies.
articles.abstract_cn: 利率是储蓄和投资决策的核心决定因素。有成本的金融中介通过制造存款利率与贷款利率之间的利差，扭曲了这些价格信号。本研究考察银行利差如何影响旨在重新配置资本的气候政策。我们在一个动态一般均衡模型中识别了利差影响碳排放的多种渠道。利率利差因资本密集型无碳能源的相对价格上升而增加了减排成本，但也因整体经济增长放缓而倾向于减少排放。对于5.1个百分点的全球平均利率利差，与无摩擦经济相比，全球变暖增加了0.2°C。对于要实现给定的温度目标，利率利差需要大幅提高碳税。当利差源于中介部门的不完全竞争时，相关的福利成本可以通过清洁能源补贴来降低，甚至可以通过全经济范围的投资补贴来消除。
